# A USD bill settled out of a CAD bank, with no rate stated.
#
# The conversion refusal on the bill side. The bank is CAD and the payable is
# USD, so what settles the bill is not what left the bank, and the parked
# split's own figure is CAD scaffolding rather than a conversion of anything.
#
# The refusal says so, and names the record's own account while it does — the
# **payable**, this being a bill.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal asking for the figures to be written
# out, with the entry untouched.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_linking_a_split_not_on_the_receivable.py.
bill "BILL-USD-001"
  vendor_id: "V-US"
  currency: USD
  date_opened: 2026-01-05
  entry:
    date: 2026-01-05
    description: "Parts"
    account: "Expenses:Supplies"
    quantity: 1
    price: 100
    taxable: false
  posted:
    date: 2026-01-05
    due: 2026-02-05
    ap_account: "Liabilities:Accounts Payable USD"
    memo: "Bill BILL-USD-001"
    accumulate: true
  payment:
    date: 2026-04-04
    amount: 100
